info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Utility Billing Reminders-v1-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Reminders API provides a streamlined way for consumers to access and manage utility billing reminders across various services. This endpoint allows users to retrieve pertinent reminders related to their billing cycles, ensuring timely payments and compliance. Typical use cases include integration into customer dashboards or alerts for end-users, enhancing customer engagement and reducing payment delays. By offering structured reminder data, this API facilitates efficient billing management and improves overall customer satisfaction.

get.description: This endpoint retrieves the current billing reminder details for the user, including payment due dates and outstanding amounts. Use this to stay updated on your billing status.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve billing reminders. Ensure that the request includes all necessary parameters to fetch the appropriate billing reminders.

200.description: Successful retrieval of billing reminder information.

ListUtilityBillingRemindersRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to billing reminders.

ListUtilityBillingRemindersResponse_200.title: Billing Reminder Response

status.description: Indicates whether the request was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the billing reminder.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the billing operation.

state.description: The current state of the billing reminder.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the billing reminder.

audit.description: Audit information for the billing reminder.

ListUtilityBillingRemindersResponse_200.description: Response schema for the Billing Reminder GET operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user who created the billing reminder.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the billing reminder was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the billing reminder was created automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Contains information related to the audit of the billing reminder.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds. This value helps in assessing the performance of the API.
